other_conditions: Applicant must belong to any of the following districts of Bihar: Katihar, Purnia, Madhubani, Kishanganj, Supaul, Araria, Madhepura, Saharsa, Darbhanga, Sitamarhi, Khagaria
Applicant must have agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 10 acres (4 ha)
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal
Benefits can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and by non‑ryot farmers on the basis of contract form
Beneficiaries will be selected on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis
benefits_summary: Subsidized seeds are provided at a 75% subsidy – ₹4,950 for Swarn Vaidehi and ₹5,737.50 for Sabour Makhana‑1 per hectare.
